captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a bottle holder ring and a two-piece pole clamp assembly designed for mounting. The main bottle holder is a low-profile ring with an integrated inner lip at the bottom to support the bottle's base. Connected to this ring is a semi-circular clamp section, paired with an identical opposing clamp piece rotated 180 degrees. Both clamp halves feature rectangular mounting wings with pre-drilled screw holes and washer recesses to secure the assembly around a pole.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric bottle holder that mounts to a pole using a two-part bolt-on clamp. The script should include adjustable parameters for the bottle diameter, holder height, ring thickness, bottom lip size, pole diameter, bracket wing thickness, and bolt/washer sizes.
captions.factory: The code defines two main modules: holder() and mount(). The holder() module uses difference() on concentric cylinders to create the outer ring, and conditionally adds an inner bottom lip cylinder. The mount() module combines a cylinder and a rectangular cube for the bracket wings, then subtracts a central cylinder for the pole, crops the wings with a cube, and cuts horizontal bolt holes with washer recesses. The final assembly places the holder at the origin and translates two opposing instances of the mount() module (one rotated 180 degrees) alongside it.
